Use `snl relationship list` to enumerate or search Relationships when an exact identity is not yet known.

### Agent procedure
1. Use `--query` only to narrow candidates and use cursor pagination until the required search is complete.
2. Choose an exact relationship ID from structured results, then call `snl relationship get` before relying on its current value.

### Machine-use contract
Invoke `snl relationship list` with an explicit `--root` and `--json`. Treat returned IDs and revisions as opaque. Branch on the structured status and exit code; do not scrape human-formatted output or edit `.SNL_Doc` files directly.
